name: @aimark/cli
description: The aimark CLI (Go) wrapped as an nx project

scripts.lint: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && golangci-lint run && bun run codegen:check
scripts.format: gofmt -w . && golangci-lint run && bun run codegen:check
scripts.codegen: go run github.com/atombender/go-jsonschema@v0.18.0 -p schema --only-models --output internal/schema/schema_gen.go ../../packages/schema/schemas/run.v1.json ../../packages/schema/schemas/suite-manifest.v1.json ../../packages/schema/schemas/samples.v1.json && gofmt -w internal/schema/schema_gen.go && bun run codegen:suites
scripts.codegen:suites: mkdir -p internal/suites/embedded && for d in ../../packages/suites/*/; do if [ -f "${d}manifest.json" ]; then cp "${d}manifest.json" "internal/suites/embedded/$(basename "$d").json"; fi; done
scripts.codegen:check: bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- internal/schema internal/suites/embedded || (echo 'Generated Go types or embedded suite manifests are stale. Run `mise run codegen` and commit.' && exit 1)
